book.name: Mako
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Mako

content: Yohana Mbatizaji abhatangazi bhandu kubhokana na Yesu Kristo
Aghagha nde Malobhi Manyahi ghaka Yesu Kristo, Mwana waka Chapanga.
Itumbwi ngati moghalembakike na mlota Isaya:
Yohana Mbatizaji atamika kulipololu, na konihoku abhabatiza bhandu. Akabhatangazya bhandu, “Ng'anambukaje na kughaleka mahoku ghinu na mbatizwaje nahuli Chapanga andekakya mahoku ghinu.”
Bhandu bhamaheli kuhuma ku Yudea na ku muchi wa ku Yelusalemu bhakapitiki kunja kunjowane Yohana. Bhakunjendi na kundandi mahoku ghabhu, na Yohana akabhabatizi mu Nkoka Yoludani.
Yohana akawatiki ingobhu yeyalenganakiki kwa mangoma gha chinyama chechilowakeka ngamia, na akakongiki ulamba wa chingokolu muchibhunu chaki. Chilebhi chaki chakabhi nzige na busi.
Yohana akabhatangazi bhandu, “Punyuma jangu nepani ahika mundu joabhi na makili kumbeta nenga. Ambaju hata nepani ngachembalika kujinama pahi na kumbopo mighoji ja magubasi ghaki.
Nepani nakumbatizi mwehapa kwa machi, nambu jombi anaambatiza kwa Roho Mhuhu.”
Yesu abatizwa na kulengakeka
Machobha ghanihagha Yesu akahikiki kuhuma ku muchi wa ku Nazaleti inchi ja ku Galilaya, bhela akabatiziki na Yohana mu Nkoka Yoludani.
Yesu pahoghuka pela kuhuma mu machi, kunani kumahunde kukahowiki na Roho waka Chapanga akanhelali panani jaki ngati ngunda.
Na sauti jaka Chapanga jakajowaniki kuhuma kunani kumahunde jakapwaga, “Wehapa nde wa Mwanangu wenukupaliki. Nepani nyambakiki na wehapa.”
Palapala Roho waka Chapanga akundongwi Yesu kujenda kulipololu.
Konihoku akatemi machobha alobaini akalengakika na Shetani. Na hinyama ya muchitengu akatami nayu konihoku, na bhatumika bha kunani kwaka Chapanga bhakabhi bhuntumakila.
Yesu abhakema bhalohi ncheche bhunjengalyaje
Yohana paakabhi mu chifungo, Yesu akapiti ku Galilaya kutangaza Malobhi Manyahi ghaka Chapanga.
Akapwagha, “Chikahi chihikite,” na Ukolongwa waka Chapanga uheghalile. Ng'anambukaje na kughaleka mahoku na mughahobhalya Malobhi Manyahi.
Yesu paakabhi apeta mumaheku ja bahali ja ku Galilaya, akabhaweni bhalohi bhabheli. Simoni na mbeli waki Andulea bhakalobha homba kwa nkwabho. Kwa ndandi bhakabhi bhalohe.
Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Muhika nyengalyaje, na nepani ananuntenda kubha bhalohi bha bhandu.”
Na palapala bhakajilekiki mikwabhu jabhu na bhakunjengali Yesu.
Yesu paakapiti palongi pachokopi, akabhaweni Yakobo na Yohana, bhana bhaka Zebedayo. Na bhombi bhakabhi mkati mu ngalawa jabhu bhakalenganakya mikwabhu jabhu.
Yesu akabhalohiki, na bhombi bhakundei atati wabhu Zebedayo mu ngalawa papamu na bhahenga lihengu, bhakunjengali Yesu.
Mundu joabhi na lijobhi
Yesu na bhabhulwa bhaki bhakapiti mbaka ku muchi wa ku Kapelenaumu, na palahika Lichobha la Sabato Yesu akajingi munyumba ja kuhimangani Bhayahude, na kutumbu kubhola.
Bhandu bhokapi bhabhunjowanili bhakakangichi namaa kubhola kwaki, maghambu ngachebholika ngati bhabhola bhabhu bha Shelia, nambu akalongi ngati mundu joabhi na lujiniku.
Palapala mundu joakamuliki na lijobhi, joakabhi mu nyumba ja kuhimangani Bhayahude jela, lakatumbwi kujamalila,
lakapwagha, “Wehapa wa Yesu wa ku Nazaleti, bho, upala kike kwitu tepani? Bho, upala kutukoma tepani? Tenga tukumanye wehapa wa nane, wehapa nde Mhuhu waka Chapanga!”
Yesu akandakali lijobhi jola akapwagha, “Tumbalaje chinunu! Umpita mundu hoju.”
Bhela palapala, lijobhi lela likanjeghi chihinduhindu mundu jola na mundu jola akajamali kwa sauti ngolongwa na kumpita.
Bhandu bhokapi bhabhabhi panipala bhakakangichi na kulalukanila, “Bho, aghagha henu mambu bhole? Bho, mabholu ghahenu? Mundu ajoju abhi na uwezu wa kughakanaki majobhi, na ghombi kunjowanela!”
Bhela malobhi ghaka Yesu ghakajaghani manyata ku inchi yokapi ya munkeghi ja Galilaya.
Yesu abhalamiha bhandu bhamaheli
Yesu na bhabhulwa bhaki bhakapitiki mu nyumba ja kuhimangani Bhayahude, na bhakalongini kujenda ku nyumba jaka Simoni na Andulea, najombi Yakobo na Yohana bhakapiti papamu nabhu.
Bhela, nkowanu wa chimbomba waka Simoni, akaghoni pachitanda akabhi na chitamu. Paakahikiki Yesu pela bhakumpwaghi lilobhi lenihele.
Yesu akanjendi mabhu jola, akankamwi chiwoku, na kunjangati kujema. Na chitamu hechi chikandekakili, na kutumbu kubhatumakila.
Pakamihi lyobha palajibhala, bhandu bhakundeti Yesu bhatamwa bhokapi na bhandu bhaghakamwi majobhi.
Bhandu bhokapi bha muchi ghonighola bhakalibhongini palubhanja palongi ja nyumba jela.

Yesu akabhalamihi bhandu bhamaheli bhabhabhi na hitamu yamaheli, akaghatopwi majobhi ghamaheli ghaghabhi nkati ja bhandu, kabheti ngacheaghalekiki majobhi kupwagha chindu maghambu ghakummanyiki kubha jombi nde nane.
Yesu Atangaza ku Galilaya
Chilabhu jaki, pachibhombu Yesu akapiti pandu panga na bhandu kundobha Chapanga.
Simoni na bhajaki bhakapiti kumpalapala.
Pabhakumbweni, bhakampwaghile, “Kila mundu akupalapala wehapa.”
Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Tumboka ku michi jengi ja pambipi nakatangaza na konihoku, maghambu nhikiki kwa lihengu leniheli.”
Yesu akapiti kila pandu ku Galilaya hoku, akatangaza mu nyumba ya kuhimangani Bhayahude na kughatopo majobhi.
Yesu ang'olola mundu joabhi na malohi
Lichobha limu mundu jumu joakabhi na malohi akunjendi Yesu, na kunchikamila na kundobha. “Anaupai, uweza kung'olola.”
Yesu akumboni chiha, akahatambwi chiwoku chaki, akankamwi na kumpwaghila, “Mbala! Ugholulikaje!”
Palapala chitamu cha malohi chikandekaki mundu jola, na akagholulike.
Bhela Yesu akumpwaghi ujendaje na kunkanakila,

“Ulingalya, koujenda hoku ngawampwaghi mundu jokapi jola chindu ache chenukutendi wehapa. Nambu ujenda ukalilangiha kwaka mpenganyambiku na ukabhoha nyambiku kwa ndandi ja kulama kwaku ngati moakalaghalaki Musa nahuli kulilangi kubha ulamike.”

Bhela, mundu jola akabhokiki na kutumbu kutangaza malobhi ghala pandu pokapi, na kutangaza mambu ghamaheli mbaka ikantendiki Yesu ngayijingi hotuhotu ku muchi wokapi ghola. Ikampaliki kutama kunja, pandu pa kanjika. Papamu na ghanihagha bhandu bhakunjendi kuhuma ipambala yokapi.
